summary: Frontend-only verification of the new SA License Disc PDF417 decoder + auto-fill + admin decoded grid. Executed 8 scenarios on the deployed Expo web preview at 390x844 (mobile) and confirmed all core behaviour works. Decoded card renders every expected field, colour auto-fills, clear button restores initial state, /(app)/scan opens without crash, non-license input degrades gracefully, admin vehicle detail shows the decoded KV grid (not the raw pipe blob). Login/logout regression and root-refresh redirect also still work. Auto-match of MINI did not select a make — that is expected because MINI is not in the seeded /api/vehicles/makes list (only 12 makes seeded).
action_items: OPTIONAL: seed 'MINI' (and other common SA makes: Land Rover, Volvo, Porsche, Lexus, GWM, Haval, Chery, Mahindra, Isuzu, Mitsubishi) in the DB so the Make auto-match on scan actually fires for real dealer scans. Currently only 12 makes are seeded so the auto-match will silently miss many valid discs.

OPTIONAL: DiskField grid currently uses only DECODED FROM DISC card header + a testID on the outer view. If future tests want to assert individual field values, add testIDs like license-disk-field-{vin|make|model|...} on each DiskField Text — the innerText assertion works today but per-field testIDs would be more robust.

MINOR: the console shows two dev warnings on every route load — '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web.' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not blocking, but the pointerEvents one is inside your own JSX (or a dep) and should be migrated to style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: decodeLicenseDisk is well-defended: guards on non-string input, URL-decode fallback, best-effort regex anchors, every field optional. Nothing crashes on non-disc strings (verified with 'random text no barcode' → no decoded card, no exception).

storage.setItem stores JSON.stringify(value). The test seeding pattern in the review request (localStorage.setItem('app.scan.buffer', JSON.stringify(RAW))) matches this correctly — verified end-to-end.
submit.tsx auto-fills colour only when it's empty (non-destructive) — correct behaviour on re-scan.
vehicle/[id].tsx correctly falls back to raw disk_text when decode returns zero fields (hasFields === false). Both branches tested.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded submissions FB-000002 and FB-000003 (both have license_disk_data). FB-000003 has a real-looking pipe-delimited disc string and decodes cleanly to Toyota Land Cruiser 200 with plate JC29JSGP, VIN JTMHV05J204279840, disc no 4062006H7M4L, expiry 2027-06-30.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login as dealer minitest@example.com / Mini1234! and admin admin@fourbuy.co.za / admin123. To simulate a scan on web: window.localStorage.setItem('app.scan.buffer', JSON.stringify(RAW_STRING)) then navigate to /submit — useFocusEffect picks it up. AsyncStorage on web is backed by localStorage without a key prefix. Sample disc string that decodes cleanly: %01%##%01%4025013HXOXC%KD09MBGP%CVL391X%Hatch back%MINI%COOPER S%WHITE%WMW72DH0602R05896%F273K801%2026-06-30%. Existing submission with real disc data: vehicle id e4bcadc9-09a2-472f-a854-8173b9bddbe4 (FB-000003).
